description:
Create a parametric plate-fin heat sink in FreeCAD using the Part Design workbench. 

Goal: Model a heat sink with a 50x30x3 mm base plate and 6 evenly spaced fins (50x1x15 mm each). The fins must be created using a LinearPattern feature.

Steps:
1. Create a new document and active Body in Part Design.
2. Create the base plate: 50 mm (Length) x 30 mm (Width) x 3 mm (Height).
3. Create a single fin on top of the base: 50 mm (Length) x 1 mm (Thickness) x 15 mm (Height). Position the first fin so it is centered at Y=2.5mm (or starts at Y=2mm, depending on your sketch logic), such that the array fits on the plate.
4. Use the 'LinearPattern' feature to create an array of 6 fins along the width (Y-axis) with a pitch (spacing) of 5 mm.

Final Dimensions:
- Overall Bounding Box: 50 x 30 x 18 mm
- Fin Count: 6

Save the file to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/heatsink.FCStd'.
